selection_policy: Review baseline Trackio curves and completed private evaluation before choosing the next candidate. Run one accepted submission per rolling 24-hour slot. Keep all task records, image digests, action schema and original binary reward fixed. Record decisions and results; do not treat candidate order as an automatic ranking. Revise or skip candidates made uninformative by observed data. Prepare the next batch from measured outcomes.
